title: manihot herbacea
intro: Manihot herbacea, commonly known as wild cassava or bitter manioc, is a perennial shrub native to South America and the Caribbean. This plant has been used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Manihot herbacea include treating digestive issues, fever reduction, and wound healing due to its bioactive constituents, such as saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. The health benefits of this plant also include reducing oxidative stress and improving cardiovascular health, making it a valuable resource for traditional medicine.
